design.predicate: src/lib/multiplayer/server/fogMatchAdmission.ts exports FOG_REFUSAL = "fog-projection-unavailable" and the single capability predicate noPerViewerRevealProjection(config): "no per-viewer reveal projection available for this match". Unknown (undefined) config or fogOfWar === true -> true (refuse); a known config that omits the legacy flag is fog-off. The WebSocket refusal helpers (matchLacksRevealProjection false|policy|unavailable, refuseFogSocket) are B14-0 additions to the same file.
design.metadata: GET /api/multiplayer/matches/[id] keeps authentication and participant authorization first (non-participants keep the generic 404 with no fog detail), then refuses fog-on/unknown with HTTP 403 {error:"fog-projection-unavailable"} before meta serialization. Known-off bytes unchanged.
design.history: FogAwareMatchProjectionService.projectWithIdentities (export, private-preview and history pages): for a match stream it reads authoritative config first (as Main already did); only when the predicate refuses does it verify viewer scope then the durable current seat (missing seat -> wrong-session "Authorization refused"; seat-lookup failure -> constant projection-failed), then throws ViewerProjectionError(projection-failed, fog-projection-unavailable) before any journal read. Every other stream and every known-off match goes to the parent unchanged (byte-identical fog-off path). The existing route mapping turns projection-failed into HTTP 500 with the fixed reason (parent ruling: existing mapping retained).
design.retainedHelper: fogMatchHistoryProjection is retained (exported, unserved) for the FOG chain, which owns reactivation with fresh parity proof (FOG-H). Its former route-level fog-on export tests in matchHistoryFog.test.ts are retired because the service no longer serves it; the hidden-payload / post-state journal-digest census row replaces them as the HTTP/digest proof consumed read-only by B14-HEAD.
